mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ltis_pnu (judg_seq, pnu, sido_gungu_cd, domyri_cd, mont_div_cd, main_strt_no, sub_strt_no, addr, created_time) SELECT A.judg_seq, CONCAT(A.sido_gungu_cd, A.DOMYRICD, A.mont_div_cd, A.MAINSTRTNO, A.SUBSTRTNO) AS PNU, A.sido_gungu_cd, A.DOMYRICD, A.mont_div_cd, A.MAINSTRTNO, A.SUBSTRTNO, MAX(A.rept_addr) AS REPTADDR, NOW() FROM (SELECT TRI.judg_seq, IF(TLL.judg_dt IS NOT NULL, YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(TLL.judg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')), YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(LS.ltis_mod_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'))) AS YEAR, TRI.sido_gungu_cd, CONCAT(SUBSTRING(TRI.domyri_cd, 1, 3), '00') AS DOMYRICD, TRI.mont_div_cd, LPAD(TRI.main_strt_no, 4, '0') AS MAINSTRTNO, LPAD(IFNULL(TRI.sub_strt_no, '0'), 4, '0') AS SUBSTRTNO, TRI.rept_addr FROM ltis_info TLL JOIN ltis_status LS ON TLL.judg_seq = LS.judg_seq JOIN ltis_rept_info TRI ON TLL.judg_seq = TRI.judg_seq JOIN ltis_rept_ownr_info TROI ON TRI.judg_seq = TROI.judg_seq AND TRI.rept_seq = TROI.rept_seq WHERE TRI.rept_addr IS NOT NULL AND TROI.ownr_intr_yn = 'O' AND TRI.land_obst_kind_cd = 'L') A WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ltis_pnu WHERE ltis_pnu.sido_gungu_cd = A.sido_gungu_cd AND ltis_pnu.domyri_cd = A.DOMYRICD AND ltis_pnu.mont_div_cd = A.mont_div_cd AND ltis_pnu.main_strt_no = A.MAINSTRTNO AND ltis_pnu.sub_strt_no = A.SUBSTRTNO AND ltis_pnu.judg_seq = A.judg_seq) GROUP BY A.judg_seq, A.YEAR, A.sido_gungu_cd, A.DOMYRICD, A.mont_div_cd, A.MAINSTRTNO, A.SUBSTRTNO
